text: Yes, native forest was deforested in this area in 2025. The tool observed a tree-cover loss event affecting 13.5 hectares, which corresponds to 3.91% of the asset. The source of this observation is the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13). Additionally, the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 data confirms that 98% of this area was mapped as forest in 2020. The MGAP forest map from 2021 indicates that 13.1 hectares of the deforested area was native forest, with no planted forest involved. Therefore, it is clear that native forest was deforested in 2025.
